subject: learning/code-internal-coveragegate-27ae25c955dd
statement: Package coveragegate measures repository-wide Go statement coverage from the standard coverage profile and applies a deterministic minimum. Measure runs go test uncached with -count=1, -timeout=25m, and -covermode=atomic so long hermetic suites complete under race and coverage without depending on go tool cover rounding.
intent: Preserve the implemented responsibility of internal/coveragegate after the coverage measurement timeout and deferred-cleanup lint fix.
rationale: The production unit changed to pin a 25m package timeout because the default 10m timeout aborts memory/cli under race and coverage, and to discard scratch-dir and profile-close errors with an explicit reason so whole-file errcheck stays green.
fit_criterion: Offline reconciliation finds active semantic memory explicitly covering code unit internal/coveragegate, Measure's go test args include -timeout=25m after -count=1, and deferred RemoveAll and Close errors are discarded with a reason.

provenance.note: Bind current coveragegate evidence for the 25m timeout and errcheck cleanup.
